title: Bridge, Ferry Country or Buffer: Images of Central Europe
goal: I can explain the images of the bridge, the ferry country and the buffer state for Central Europe.
I can use a metaphor and say what it claims about the region.
I can name whose view a statement about Central Europe's future is.
